newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Fed regional banks to face annual audit.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Fed regional banks to face annual audit.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said on Tuesday that each of the 12 regional Fed banks will be audited annually under an expanded contract with accounting firm Coopers and Lybrand.
The Fed said the audits would be in addition to the annual audit of combined Federal Reserve financial statements that Coopers and Lybrand has conducted since 1995.

Since 1995, the accounting firm has carried out year-end audits of the combined statements as well as individual statements from two or three regional banks per year. But now the Fed has decided the audit will be extended to all 12 regional banks.
